task_title: P2 fresh npm install on npm >=12 leaves better-sqlite3 without its native binding
task_criteria: package.json declares allowScripts.better-sqlite3=true; scripts/postinstall-lint-deps.sh provides a binding verification path exposed as npm run check:sqlite-binding; npm run check:sqlite-binding exits 0 at HEAD; CI stages the gate; README/CHANGELOG document the npm >=12 behavior

items.criterion: package.json declares allowScripts.better-sqlite3=true; scripts/postinstall-lint-deps.sh provides a binding verification path exposed as npm run check:sqlite-binding; npm run check:sqlite-binding exits 0 at HEAD; CI stages the gate; README/CHANGELOG document the npm >=12 behavior
items.detail: Four of five sub-requirements hold, the CI sub-requirement does not. (a) package.json:34-36 declares `"allowScripts": { "better-sqlite3": true }`. (b) package.json:32 exposes `"check:sqlite-binding": "bash scripts/postinstall-lint-deps.sh --sqlite-binding-only"`, and scripts/postinstall-lint-deps.sh:24-103 implements `check_sqlite_binding` (real `require('better-sqlite3')` + in-memory `SELECT 1` probe, npm-version-aware remedy, `return 1` on failure); the red path was exercised in a scratch tree with an empty node_modules/better-sqlite3 and returned REAL_EXIT=1 with the FAIL/remedy text. (c) `npm run check:sqlite-binding` at HEAD printed `OK: better-sqlite3 native binding loads (SELECT 1 -> {"x":1})` with EXIT=0. (d) README.md:36-89 documents the npm >=12 allowScripts blocking behaviour, the warning text, the check command and the remedy; CHANGELOG.md:11-27 documents the same under Unreleased. (e) FAIL — CI does NOT stage the gate: `grep -n "sqlite\|binding\|allowScripts" .github/workflows/ci.yml` returns nothing (only `run: npm ci` at ci.yml:50). The step existed in 6cb184b4 (ci.yml:52-61) but was deleted in e8343f1c ("chore(ci): stage the sqlite-binding CI step instead of pushing it") and now lives only as an unapplied patch at .coding-hermes/pending/ci-sqlite-binding-step.patch; CHANGELOG.md:14-17 itself states the step "is staged in .coding-hermes/pending/ci-sqlite-binding-step.patch". A staged patch is not a CI stage. Test evidence: `npx vitest run tests/cli/pack-contract.test.ts` -> `Test Files 1 passed (1) / Tests 3 passed (3)`, exit 0.

items.criterion: The binding gate is actually enforced by CI at HEAD, so a regression that drops the native binding turns a CI run red
items.detail: .github/workflows/ci.yml has no step running `npm run check:sqlite-binding`; the only install-related step is `- name: Install dependencies / run: npm ci` at ci.yml:50. `git log --oneline -- .github/workflows/ci.yml` shows e8343f1c removed the 11-line step that 6cb184b4 had added, so nothing in CI would catch a fresh install that leaves better-sqlite3 without its binding — the exact defect this task exists to prevent. The gate is only reachable via the local `postinstall` hook (package.json:31) and the manual `npm run check:sqlite-binding`.
